spec.title: D8 routing on terrains with known answers
spec.question: On synthetic terrains whose drainage is known analytically, does D8 route water in the right direction, conserve it, and deliver it to the right outlets?
spec.hypothesis: On every case, D8 directions lie within 45° of the analytic downslope direction, and at least 99% of water reaches the analytically expected outlets.

conditions.variants: original D8 (v1); plain fill (rejected); fill-and-spill (v2, shipped)

metrics: mean and maximum angular deviation from analytic downslope (degrees)
share of water reaching expected outlets
share of cells that are interior sinks
limitations: Synthetic surfaces verify the algorithm, not its fidelity to any real street network.
